benchmarks.name: HUMAN_TP53_CDS_TOP_HIT
benchmarks.description: Human p53 CDS nucleotide sequence must resolve to the TP53 gene / P04637-encoding transcript.
benchmarks.ground_truth: Human TP53 transcript NM_000546 is the reference RefSeq for p53 mRNA.
benchmarks.citation: NCBI RefSeq NM_000546.6; Matlashewski G. et al. EMBO J. 1984.

benchmarks.name: HUMAN_HBB_CDS_TOP_HIT
benchmarks.description: Human beta-globin CDS must resolve to the HBB gene (NM_000518).
benchmarks.ground_truth: Human HBB transcript NM_000518 is the reference RefSeq for beta-globin mRNA.
benchmarks.citation: NCBI RefSeq NM_000518.5; Lawn R.M. et al. Cell 1980.
